text: Fig. 1.1 shows two identical cylindrical metal conductors P and Q, each of length L and

The conductors are placed parallel to each other. The perpendicular distance from the midpoint of
P to point X is p. The perpendicular distance from the midpoint of Q to point X is q.

in series to a power supply and a resistor. The potential difference V between the ends of P is the
same as the potential difference between the ends of Q.
